# awx_workflow_job_template_node_associate_failure_node (Resource)

Associates an AWX failure node with an AWX workflow job template node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awx_workflow_job_template_node_associate_failure_node" "build_to_notify" {
  workflow_job_template_node_id = awx_workflow_job_template_node.build.id
  failure_node_id               = awx_workflow_job_template_node.notify.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `failure_node_id` (Number) Database ID of the failurenode to assign.
- `workflow_job_template_node_id` (Number) Database ID for this WorkflowJobTemplateNode.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <workflow_job_template_node_id>/<failure_node_id>
import {
  to = awx_workflow_job_template_node_associate_failure_node.example
  id = "1/2"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <workflow_job_template_node_id>/<failure_node_id>
terraform import awx_workflow_job_template_node_associate_failure_node.example 1/2
```
